newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo to register new diabetes pill.
newsitem.headline: Novo to register new diabetes pill.

text.p: Danish pharmaceutical and biotechnological group Novo Nordisk A/S said on Monday it planned in 1997 to register in Europe and the United States its first NovoNorm type two diabetes product.
"NovoNorm will be sent in for registration in both Europe and the United States this year," Novo Nordisk Health Care unit chief Ingelise Saunders told Reuters in an interview.
Registration is required before the product can be launched in the various markets, but Saunders could not say when NovoNorm would actually be available for sale.

She said that 90 percent of all diabetes patients suffered from the type two variant of the disease, making them a huge market for Novo Nordisk, which already sells half of its insulin products to the group.

"The type two diabetics market is currently in the process of major expansion, nothing much has happened on this front in recent years, so doctors and patients are ready to try new tablets," Saunders said.
"NovoNorm is the first fast-working tablet, a more flexible treatment for type two diabetics," she said.
